steps.code:
# Let's search for all songs and find the matching song IDs
# Parse each line into title and artists
import re

song_ids = []
for line in song_lines[1:]:
    # Split on " by " to get title and artist part
    parts = line.split(' by ')
    title = parts[0].strip()
    artists_part = parts[1].strip() if len(parts) > 1 else ''
    # Split artists by comma
    artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_part.split(',')]
    
    # Search for the song
    results = apis.spotify.search_songs(query=line, access_token=spotify_login['access_token'])
    
    # Find the exact match: title matches and all artists are present
    matched = None
    for song in results:
        if song['title'].lower() == title.lower():
            song_artists = [a['name'].lower() for a in song['artists']]
            if all(any(artist.lower() == sa for sa in song_artists) for artist in artists):
                matched = song
                break
    
    if matched:
        song_ids.append(matched['song_id'])
        print(f"Found: {line} -> song_id={matched['song_id']}")
    else:
        print(f"NOT FOUND: {line}")

print(f"\nTotal found: {len(song_ids)}")
